title: Restore fail-closed Swarm PR ownership checker
objective: Complete the critical PR-ownership recovery after #288 restored trusted hardening imports but exposed a fail-open V2.1 facade: swarmctl_hardening.py discards the base CLI return code, so rejected ownership checks can exit 0. Repair exit propagation, restore valid live control state, and mechanically prove both negative rejection and positive PASS behavior.
acceptance: swarmctl_hardening.py propagates the base CLI exit status so every ControlError exits nonzero
trusted pr-ownership validation still executes only base-branch validator code and dependencies
live swarm-control validates cleanly instead of relying on swallowed errors
a mechanically executed negative pr-check is rejected with a nonzero process exit
a real valid product PR receives explicit JSON status PASS from pr-check and a green ownership job
control-plane deterministic/adversarial tests and canonical CI remain green
notes: #288 fixed dependency materialization but run 31465489200 exposed the pre-existing fail-open facade: the validator printed a ControlError while GitHub marked pr-ownership successful because `_base.main()` was not passed to SystemExit. The same run surfaced this lane's invalid priority 20000; this control-state repair normalizes it to the schema maximum 10000. Durable finding: evt-20260811-063523-pr-check-fail-open-r4m8z2. New primary implementation should remain paused until this lane is independently verified.
